detached_structure.evidence: Small white shed-like structure on the lawn south-east of the central house, plus a small gray outbuilding and a small greenhouse-like frame to the south-west that may sit on this lot or the neighboring one.

signals.notes: The central ranch-style house has a weathered gray roof and large dark ornamental trees to the north and south; the shared driveway on the west side is unclear, and the parked cars to the west probably belong to the neighboring lot.
